# GPS almanac fixture

`yuma_2026_311.alm`: the GPS almanac of 7 November 2026 (day 311) in the YUMA format, published by the U.S.
Coast Guard Navigation Center at
<https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/sites/default/files/gps/almanac/2026/Yuma/311.alm>, retrieved 8 November 2026.
19,008 bytes, SHA-256 `6baa60d1021281e93b6e1ef5cafbb1d909c0640d8bcbc4d97a0479f13ec9b8ad`. Week 396 (modulo 1024; GPS
week 2444), 32 satellites, all healthy. A U.S. Government work, kept unchanged. Used by `tests/almanac_hdop.rs` and
`xval/almanac-hdop/` (D18, item 1).
